controls.title: Hooks follow the rules of hooks
controls.rationale: Conditional or nested hook calls break React's state ordering.
controls.remediation: Call hooks unconditionally at the top level of components and custom hooks.

verification.description: Run React Doctor on the changed files.

controls.title: List keys are stable
controls.rationale: Index keys reorder state and DOM when lists change.
controls.remediation: Key list items by a stable identifier from the data.

verification.description: Run React Doctor on the changed files.

controls.title: Components are not defined inside other components
controls.rationale: A nested component definition remounts on every parent render.
controls.remediation: Move the component to module scope and pass what it needs as props.

verification.description: Run React Doctor on the changed files.

controls.title: Component files export only components
controls.rationale: Mixed exports make Fast Refresh reload the page and lose state.

verification.description: Run React Doctor on the changed files.
